in_sanskrit.name: पिनाक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: समुंढ़ित बाण और धनुष (सिंहासन, वज्र, असि दण्ड, तार, शिवजी के धनुष साथ जोते हैं)

in_hindi.name: Pinak
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Wealth
in_hindi.long_meaning: Pinak एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who holds the lotus in his hand, representing wealth and prosperity. This name is derived from the Hindu god Pinaka, who is also known as Lord Kartikeya or Murugan.

in_tamil.name: Pinak
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord of Wealth
in_tamil.long_meaning: Pinak ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who holds the lotus in his hand, representing wealth and prosperity. This name is derived from the Hindu god Pinaka, who is also known as Lord Kartikeya or Murugan.

in_telugu.name: Pinak
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of Wealth
in_telugu.long_meaning: Pinak ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who holds the lotus in his hand, representing wealth and prosperity. This name is derived from the Hindu god Pinaka, who is also known as Lord Kartikeya or Murugan.

in_marathi.name: Pinak
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pinak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who holds the lotus in his hand, representing wealth and prosperity. This name is derived from the Hindu god Pinaka, who is also known as Lord Kartikeya or Murugan.

in_bengali.name: Pinak
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Wealth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Pinak একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who holds the lotus in his hand, representing wealth and prosperity. This name is derived from the Hindu god Pinaka, who is also known as Lord Kartikeya or Murugan.
